assistants.title: Assistants
assistants.description: Manage assistant profiles. Changes show up on the chat page immediately.
assistants.delete_confirm: Delete assistant "{{name}}"? Its conversations and memories will also be removed.
assistants.cannot_delete_default: The default assistant cannot be deleted

tags.delete_confirm: Delete tag "{{name}}"? Bindings on all assistants will also be removed.

prompt_sections.desc: Enabled sections are joined in order with a blank line between them. Titles are only labels and are not sent to the model.
prompt_sections.title: Title
prompt_sections.whole_merged_hint: Showing the joined text of the enabled sections. Edits here go into the matching sections.

local_tools.title: Local tools
local_tools.hint: These tools run on the phone; the switches here only change the assistant configuration. They do not trigger Android permission prompts and never touch the browser clipboard. Grant any required system permissions in the app first.

javascript_engine.label: JavaScript engine
javascript_engine.desc: Run JavaScript in the QuickJS sandbox on the phone for calculations and scripting; no DOM and no Node.js APIs.

time_info.label: Time info
time_info.desc: Read the current date, weekday, time and timezone from the phone.

clipboard.label: Clipboard
clipboard.desc: Reads and writes the phone clipboard (not the browser clipboard); Android restricts clipboard reads in the background, so reads may fail while the app is not in the foreground.

tts.label: Text to speech
tts.desc: Read text aloud on the phone with the TTS service selected in the app.

ask_user.label: Ask user
ask_user.desc: Let the AI ask you questions for clarification; the web chat already has a matching approval form.

screen_time.label: Screen time
screen_time.desc: Let the AI read app screen-time usage; requires granting Usage Access manually in the phone's system settings — this switch does not grant it.

calendar.label: Calendar
calendar.desc: Let the AI query and create calendar events; requires READ_CALENDAR / WRITE_CALENDAR permissions granted on the phone (in the app).

chart_display.label: Native charts
chart_display.desc: Let the AI display line, bar and scatter charts with data tables in the Android app. Image export is a manual app action; this switch does not save images or add a browser chart renderer.

hints.creator_no_workspace: The creator cannot be bound to a workspace.

memory.title: Memory
memory.scope_assistant_hint: Only this assistant reads and writes this memory store.
memory.scope_global_hint: Shared by every assistant with “Use global memory” on.
memory.switch_to_global_after_save: After saving, this list switches to the global memory store.
memory.switch_to_assistant_after_save: After saving, this list switches to this assistant's memory store.
memory.empty: No memory files yet. Once memory is on, chats are organized into files in the background (dreaming); you can also add one.
memory.edit_warning: Try not to edit memories by hand; asking the assistant in chat to remember or change something works better. The version is checked when saving.
memory.gone: This memory file no longer exists (the assistant, dreaming or the app may have deleted it). The list was refreshed.
memory.changed: This memory file changed since it was opened (dreaming may have updated it). Your edit was not saved; copy it, then edit again.
memory.path_taken: A memory file already exists at this path
memory.error_path: Use an absolute path ending in .md, e.g. /topics/food.md
memory.error_too_large: A memory file can be at most {{max}} KB
memory.dream_hint: Organizes chats into memory once they pause
memory.dream_manual_hint: Automatic dreaming is off; tap Dream now to organize

skills.title: Skills
skills.hint: Enabled skills are listed to the model, which loads one when it needs it.

providers.title: Providers
providers.description: Configure API providers and models. Saving connection settings will not overwrite imported models.
providers.interactions_hint: Opt in to Gemini Interactions for text requests. Off by default; changes apply only after saving.
providers.interactions_vertex_hint: Interactions API is unavailable with Vertex AI. Your saved choice is retained.

headers.title: Provider custom headers
headers.common_name: Add a common header name (empty value)
headers.format_hint: Use [{"name":"X-Header","value":""}]. Names and values must be literal strings. Blank names are ignored; other names must be RFC7230 tokens. Values allow printable ASCII and TAB only, not CR/LF, DEL or Unicode. Values are saved without trimming; OkHttp may trim them at transport.
headers.priority_hint: Request/model/assistant headers replace same-name provider headers (case-insensitive). Provider headers cannot replace adapter/OAuth credentials; existing request-level authentication-header behavior is unchanged, so avoid duplicate credential headers. A manual provider session header overrides a generated standalone default, but an explicit conversation ID wins.
headers.save_hint: Use Save configuration to apply these headers. Empty input or [] clears all provider headers. Unsaved drafts survive settings updates. Values may contain secrets: do not share them. Names are suggested without values or credentials.

errors.shape: Headers must be an array of objects with literal string name and value fields.
errors.name: Nonblank header names must be RFC7230 tokens (no spaces or Unicode).
errors.value: Header values allow ASCII 32–126 or TAB only; CR/LF, DEL and Unicode are not allowed.

fields.name: Name
fields.api_key_hint: Leave blank to keep the stored credential. Enter a new value to replace it, or save an empty field to clear.
fields.private_key_hint: Leave blank to keep the stored credential. Enter a new value to replace it, or save an empty field to clear.

hints.context_length: The model's context window in tokens, used for the context share in usage details; default 1,000,000

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.description: Manage quick messages, mode injections, lorebooks, and MCP servers.
extensions.delete_confirm: Delete "{{name}}"? Bindings on all assistants will also be removed.

fields.title: Title
fields.tools_readonly: Tools are synced after connecting and cannot be edited here.

cache_keep_alive.title: Cache keep-alive
cache_keep_alive.enable_desc: After each real request starts, replay it with a 1-token output limit before the cache expires. Each replay is a billed request.
cache_keep_alive.max_duration_desc: Default 30 minutes, counted from the start of the latest real request
cache_keep_alive.error_interval: Interval must be a positive integer
cache_keep_alive.error_max_duration: Limit must be a positive integer
cache_keep_alive.error_max_le_interval: Limit must be longer than the interval
cache_keep_alive.note: Keep-alive stops when a replay fails, the context changes, it is more than 15 seconds late, or the limit is reached; it restarts on your next request.

tool_execution.title: Tool execution
tool_execution.description: How tool calls are run when the model issues several of them in one reply.
tool_execution.parallel_desc: Independent read-only calls and subagents in one reply run at the same time; calls that change files or state still run one at a time, in order.
tool_execution.mcp_empty: No MCP tools have been synced yet.
tool_execution.default_off: Default: runs one at a time
tool_execution.view_only: only the view command runs in parallel

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Skills are folders with a SKILL.md that assistants can load on demand. Enable them per assistant on the assistant page or in the chat extension picker.
skills.import_file_hint: A .zip with one or more skill folders, or a single SKILL.md (up to 16 MiB).
skills.name: Name
skills.name_hint: Cannot contain / or \ or start with a dot. The name cannot be changed later.
skills.description_placeholder: When should the assistant use this skill?
skills.github_hint: Downloaded by the phone through the GitHub API. Same limits as file imports.

invalid_dirs.title: Unrecognized folders
invalid_dirs.reason_missing_skill_md: No SKILL.md file in this folder
invalid_dirs.delete_confirm: Delete the folder {{name}} and everything in it? This cannot be undone.

errors.SKILL_EXISTS: A skill with this name already exists
errors.SKILL_INVALID: Not a valid skill: SKILL.md needs name and description in its frontmatter
errors.SKILL_TOO_LARGE: The import exceeds the size or file count limit
errors.GITHUB_RATE_LIMIT: GitHub rate limit reached; try again later
errors.SKILL_READ_ONLY: Built-in skills are read-only; copy it to edit
errors.SKILL_CHANGED: The skill changed elsewhere; reload and retry
errors.SKILL_NAME_CHANGED: The name field in SKILL.md cannot be changed
errors.SKILL_DESCRIPTION_MISSING: The description field in SKILL.md is required
errors.FILE_EXISTS: A file with this path already exists
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large to edit here
errors.SKILL_DIR_CHANGED: The folder changed or is gone; reload and retry

detail.new_file_invalid: Invalid path: use a relative path without .. segments
detail.binary_hint: Binary or large file ({{size}}). It cannot be edited here.
detail.readonly_builtin: Built-in skill: read-only. Copy it to a user skill to make changes; the copy then takes precedence.
detail.copy_to_edit: Copy as user skill to edit
detail.copied: Copied. You can edit it now.
detail.override_hint: This user skill overrides a built-in skill with the same name.
detail.delete_skill_confirm: Delete the skill {{name}} and all its files? This cannot be undone.
detail.delete_override_confirm: Delete your copy of {{name}}? The built-in version will be used again.
detail.deleted_revealed: Deleted. The built-in version is active again.
detail.conflict: This file was changed elsewhere. Reload to see the latest version (your edits will be lost).

tuiqiao.title: Refine
tuiqiao.description: Refine in the workspace text editor: candidates, refine roles, the file types it works in, and default prompts. Same settings as the app's Settings → Refine.
tuiqiao.roles_hint: Roles that match the current level each take one candidate slot, in list order. Each role is a separate request that sends the preceding text again. Roles don't use the assistant's prompt or any tools.
tuiqiao.role_prompt_hint: e.g. Add a humorous, sarcastic narrator aside to the selection
tuiqiao.role_model_hint: "Assistant's model" uses the current assistant's model.
tuiqiao.model_missing: Model no longer exists; using the assistant's model
tuiqiao.role_invalid: Name, request and at least one position are required.
tuiqiao.saturated: {{mode}}: roles fill all {{count}} slots; no regular candidates.
tuiqiao.files_hint: Refine works in these files. md and markdown keep Markdown formatting; the rest are plain text (one line is one paragraph).
tuiqiao.extension_invalid: The editor can't open .{{ext}} as text.
tuiqiao.prompts_hint: Variables: {count} number of options, {explanation} explanation rule. The document context and the output format are attached automatically.

zaizao.title: Recast
zaizao.description: Recast in the workspace text editor: select text, write what to change, and the selection is rewritten as an edit, an expansion or a full rewrite, round after round. No assistant prompt or tools are used. Same settings as Settings → Recast in the app.
zaizao.model_missing: The chosen model no longer exists; the assistant's model is used
zaizao.model_hint: "Assistant model" uses the current assistant's chat model.
zaizao.include_after: Send the text after the selection
zaizao.include_after_hint: On: everything after the selection is sent. Off: none of it is, so the model need not connect to what follows. Can be switched for each recast in the panel.

type_hints.MODIFY: Keep the draft and change parts of it as asked
type_hints.INCREMENT: Keep the draft and add new content as asked
type_hints.REWRITE: Extract the events and facts, then write it anew in a different way without reusing earlier techniques

zaizao.prompts_hint: Each prompt describes that type's task only; the document, the draft, your requirement and the output format are added automatically.
zaizao.files_link: Change them in the Refine settings

prompt_polish.title: Polish
prompt_polish.description: The polish button in the chat input: the model below rewrites what you typed so it reads clearer and leaves no room for misreading. The result replaces the input and can be undone. Same settings as Settings → Polish in the app.
prompt_polish.model_hint: "Assistant model" uses the current assistant's chat model.
prompt_polish.model_missing: The model no longer exists; the assistant's model is used
prompt_polish.context_hint: Also send the latest messages of this conversation (text only) so the model can resolve references. Off by default.
prompt_polish.prompt_hint: Variables: {input} the text to polish; {context} the conversation context (empty when off).
